question: Which six-syllabled mantra is invoked to protect the speaker's two hands?
premises: Protection of both hands is requested
The mantra is identified as six-syllabled
inference: The six-syllabled mantra krīṃ krīṃ hūṃ hūṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ protects my hands.
plain_english: May the six-syllabled mantra krīṃ krīṃ hūṃ hūṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ protect my two hands.
